adjudication.rationale: The finding identifies a real logic issue. In parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts (lines 14-18), the condition `if (APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT)` selects minimumTokenResponseSchema regardless of whether the credential belongs to a user or team. However, refreshOAuthTokens.ts (lines 5-6) shows that team credentials (userId=null) are routed to the provider's refresh function, not the sync endpoint. This means when APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is true and a team credential refreshes tokens, parseRefreshTokenResponse will use the minimal schema instead of the full provider schema, potentially losing provider-specific fields like refresh_token. The schemas differ - minimumTokenResponseSchema only requires access_token and a number field, while provider schemas include refresh_token and other fields.
